name: ASSET combat-loop 90s
annotation:
本轮战斗原型的循环音乐

Prompt:
Purpose: looping combat music for the "Candle Prototype Arena" top-down wave-defense prototype (NIGHT-001).
Style: dark synth pulse, tense but minimal; 100-110 BPM; low-pass filtered layers that can loop seamlessly.
Length: 60-90 seconds, seamless loop (no intro/outro fade).
Format: OGG (Unity streaming), stereo, 48 kHz, -16 LUFS integrated.
Constraints: no vocals, no sudden key changes mid-loop; must sit under frequent gunshots and UI beeps; melody sparse.
Technical: deliver as loopable OGG; if WAV provided, cut at a bar boundary with no reverb tail.
Reference scene: night phase of a top-down arena defense; enemies entering from four gates; player kiting in the middle.
prototype_only: placeholder until reviewed.
